title: Engineer Your Coding Agents Like Any Other System — Zach Lloyd, Warp
description:
Most developers still run coding agents locally and prompt them one at a time, which caps throughput and makes cost, security and governance hard to manage. Zach Lloyd, founder and CEO of Warp and former Google Docs engineering lead, defines a software factory as a code-defined, closed-loop system for continuously measuring and improving cloud coding agents. He walks through the stack: factories as code, recorded agent runs, sandboxed compute, swappable models and harnesses, and orchestration. He demos live team views, online evals, self-improvement through PRs and benchmarks on your own data.
